1: // Simple Space Junk Collector game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
10: 
11:   // Game settings
12:   const shipWidth = 40;
13:   // Sound manager
14:   let audioCtx = null;
15:   const getAudioCtx = () => {
16:     if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
17:     return audioCtx;
18:   };
19:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
20:     const ctx = getAudioCtx();
21:     const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
22:     const gain = ctx.createGain();
23:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
24:     osc.type = 'sine';
25:     osc.connect(gain);
26:     gain.connect(ctx.destination);
27:     const now = ctx.currentTime;
28:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
29:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
30:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration);
31:     osc.start(now);
32:     osc.stop(now + duration);
33:   };
34:   const playShoot = () => playTone(400, 0.1);
35:   const playCapture = () => playTone(600, 0.1);
36:   const playExplosion = () => playTone(200, 0.3);
37:   const playGameOver = () => playTone(150, 0.5);
38:   const shipHeight = 20;
39:   const hookWidth = 4;
40:   const hookSpeed = 6;
41:   const debrisSpeed = 2;
42:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
43:   const gameDuration = 60; // seconds
44: 
45:   let left = false, right = false, fire = false;
46:   let score = 0;
47:   let timeLeft = gameDuration;
48:   let lastSpawn = 0;
49:   let lastTimerTick = performance.now();
50:   let gameOver = false;
51: 
52:   const ship = {
53:     x: W / 2 - shipWidth / 2,
54:     y: H - shipHeight - 5,
55:     w: shipWidth,
56:     h: shipHeight,
57:     speed: 5,
58:   };
59: 
60:   const hook = {
61:     active: false,
62:     extending: false,
63:     x: 0,
64:     y: 0,
65:     length: 0,
66:     maxLen: H / 2,
67:   };
68: 
69:   const debris = [];
70: 
71:   // Input handling
72:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
73:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = true;
74:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = true;
75:     if (e.key === ' ') fire = true;
76:   });
77:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
78:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = false;
79:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = false;
80:     if (e.key === ' ') fire = false;
81:   });
82: 
83:   function spawnDebris() {
84:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
85:     const isDanger = Math.random() < 0.2; // asteroid
86:     debris.push({
87:       x: Math.random() * (W - size),
88:       y: -size,
89:       w: size,
90:       h: size,
91:       speed: debrisSpeed + Math.random(),
92:       danger: isDanger,
93:       captured: false,
94:     });
95:   }
96: 
97:   function update(dt) {
98:     if (gameOver) return;
99: 
100:     // Move ship
101:     if (left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
102:     if (right) ship.x += ship.speed;
103:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
104: 
105:     // Hook logic
106:     if (fire && !hook.active) {
107:       hook.active = true;
108:       hook.extending = true;
109:       hook.x = ship.x + ship.w / 2 - hookWidth / 2;
110:       hook.y = ship.y;
111:       hook.length = 0;
112:       playShoot();
113:     }
114:     if (hook.active) {
115:       if (hook.extending) {
116:         hook.length += hookSpeed;
117:         if (hook.length >= hook.maxLen) hook.extending = false;
118:       } else {
119:         hook.length -= hookSpeed;
120:         if (hook.length <= 0) hook.active = false;
121:       }
122:       // Collision with debris while extending
123:       if (hook.extending) {
124:         const tipX = hook.x + hookWidth / 2;
125:         const tipY = hook.y - hook.length;
126:         debris.forEach(d => {
127:           if (!d.captured && tipX > d.x && tipX < d.x + d.w && tipY > d.y && tipY < d.y + d.h) {
128:             d.captured = true;
129:             score += d.danger ? 0 : 10; // danger gives no points
130:             if (!d.danger) playCapture();
131:           }
132:         });
133:       }
134:     }
135: 
136:     // Update debris
137:     debris.forEach(d => {
138:       if (!d.captured) d.y += d.speed;
139:     });
140:     // Remove off‑screen or captured debris
141:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
142:       const d = debris[i];
143:       if (d.captured) {
144:         // simple retract effect: nothing to do
145:         debris.splice(i, 1);
146:         continue;
147:       }
148: if (d.y > H) {
149:           // lost debris – end game
150:           gameOver = true;
151:           playExplosion();
152:         }
153:         // collision with ship (danger only)
154:         if (d.danger &&
155:             d.x < ship.x + ship.w && d.x + d.w > ship.x &&
156:             d.y < ship.y + ship.h && d.y + d.h > ship.y) {
157:           gameOver = true;
158:           playExplosion();
159:         }
160:     }
161: 
162:     // Spawn new debris
163:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
164:       spawnDebris();
165:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
166:     }
167: 
168:     // Timer
169:     const now = performance.now();
170:     if (now - lastTimerTick >= 1000) {
171:       timeLeft--;
172:       lastTimerTick = now;
173:       if (timeLeft <= 0) { gameOver = true; playGameOver(); }
174:     }
175:   }
176: 
177: function draw() {
178:   // Background: dark space with starfield
179:   ctx.fillStyle = '#001020';
180:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
181:   drawStars();
182: 
183:   // Ship (triangle with slight gradient)
184:   const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
185:   shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00aaff');
186:   shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004466');
187:   ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
188:   ctx.beginPath();
189:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
190:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
191:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
192:   ctx.closePath();
193:   ctx.fill();
194: 
195:   // Hook (white line with circular tip)
196:   if (hook.active) {
197:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
198:     ctx.lineWidth = hookWidth;
199:     ctx.beginPath();
200:     ctx.moveTo(hook.x + hookWidth / 2, hook.y);
201:     ctx.lineTo(hook.x + hookWidth / 2, hook.y - hook.length);
202:     ctx.stroke();
203:     // tip circle
204:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
205:     ctx.beginPath();
206:     ctx.arc(hook.x + hookWidth / 2, hook.y - hook.length, hookWidth * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
207:     ctx.fill();
208:   }
209: 
210:   // Debris: junk as gray rectangles, asteroids as red polygons
211:   debris.forEach(d => {
212:     if (d.danger) {
213:       // draw asteroid as rough polygon
214:       ctx.fillStyle = '#b33';
215:       ctx.beginPath();
216:       const cx = d.x + d.w / 2;
217:       const cy = d.y + d.h / 2;
218:       const points = 7;
219:       for (let i = 0; i < points; i++) {
220:         const angle = (i / points) * Math.PI * 2;
221:         const radius = d.w / 2 * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6);
222:         ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius, cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius);
223:       }
224:       ctx.closePath();
225:       ctx.fill();
226:     } else {
227:       ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
228:       ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
229:     }
230:   });
231: 
232:   // UI overlay
233:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
234:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
235:   ctx.textAlign = 'left';
236:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
237:   ctx.fillText(`Time: ${timeLeft}`, W - 100, 20);
238: 
239:   if (gameOver) {
240:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
241:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
242:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
243:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
244:     ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
245:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
246:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
247:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
248:   }
249: }
250: 
251: // Starfield helper (simple static stars)
252: const stars = [];
253: function initStars(count = 100) {
254:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
255:     stars.push({
256:       x: Math.random() * W,
257:       y: Math.random() * H,
258:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
259:     });
260:   }
261: }
262: function drawStars() {
263:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
264:   stars.forEach(s => {
265:     ctx.beginPath();
266:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
267:     ctx.fill();
268:   });
269: }
270: 
271: // Initialize stars once
272: initStars();
273: 
274:     // Debris
275:     debris.forEach(d => {
276:       ctx.fillStyle = d.danger ? '#f44' : '#aaa';
277:       ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
278:     });
279: 
280:     // UI
281:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
282:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
283:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
284:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${timeLeft}`, W - 100, 20);
285:     if (gameOver) {
286:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
287:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
288:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
289:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
290:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
291:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
292:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
293:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
294:     }
295:   }
296: 
297:   function loop(timestamp) {
298:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame || timestamp);
299:     lastFrame = timestamp;
300:     update(dt);
301:     draw();
302:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
303:   }
304:   let lastFrame = null;
305:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
306: })();
